headline: Committee defers ferry study and Lahaina Harbor update after public input on ferry

meeting.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, and Public Transportation Committee
meeting.summary: The committee deferred both the ferry study item and the Lahaina Harbor update with no objections. The department said it is preparing cost estimates and will turn first-round results into proposals for further engagement with the council and community.
meeting.recap: A testifier urged the County to help keep the ferry going.[[0:05:48]] The chair said the fiscal year 2024 budget included $300,000 to study a county-owned ferry.[[0:06:42]] Common concerns from the public included marine animals, zero-emission ferries, getting to the ferry by land, and kamaʻāina (resident) fares.[[0:18:27]] Molokaʻi participants said two ferry trips a day would be enough.[[0:21:26]] A second testifier said there is no oversight for invasive species where the ferry docks.[[0:29:13]] The council chair said the council's main concern is cost.[[0:38:44]] The committee chair said Representative Jill Tokuda told him federal ferry money is available if the County owns it.[[0:41:30]] The committee chair said the current ferry owners hired someone to find a buyer.[[0:50:19]] The deputy director of transportation apologized for a lack of cultural sensitivity in the survey.[[1:00:00]] The deputy director said they will remain the study's project manager after moving to the MPO on September 1st.[[1:07:29]] The committee deferred the ferry study item with no objections.[[1:08:30]] The chair said nearly 90 boats in Lahaina Harbor were destroyed on August 8th last year.[[1:08:59]] State boating staff missed the harbor update to help boat owners prepare for storms.[[1:09:40]] The committee deferred the harbor update with no objections.[[1:11:00]]
meeting.next: The department will turn first-round results into proposals and engage the council and community again. The department said it is putting together cost estimates for the ferry.
